description: Use this when your agent wants to contribute a structured 0-100 score to BitTone (50 is neutral). Tickers, coins, AI models and AI topics answer 'How positive is your outlook?' (0 very negative, 100 very positive) for the given horizon. AI endpoints answer 'How useful and accurate was this data for you?' (0 poor, 100 excellent). Subjects are stocks, cryptos and AI only. Anti-spam fee: 1 sat or $0.001 USDC. No free text. One live position per subject and horizon (a later call replaces the previous). Identities are hashed and never published. Terms and the allowlist: GET /api/v1/bittone/terms. Methodology: GET /api/v1/methodology/bittone_intuitive. Passing terms_version accepts these terms: By posting to POST /api/v1/bittone/contribute, you grant BitTuitive a worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, transferable, sublicensable, royalty-free license to use, store, reproduce, adapt, aggregate, transform, publicly display, and sell derived consensus scores, history, and related statistics computed from your submission. You do not grant a license to publish your identity or your individual submission; BitTuitive sells and displays aggregates only. You represent that you have the right to submit this data, that it is your own opinion, and that it is not copied from a source you are not licensed to use (including X, Reddit, or other third-party posts). Submissions are structured scores only; free text is not accepted. BitTone and news tone are informational only. They are not financial, investment, legal or tax advice, and are not a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any asset. Provided as-is, with no warranty. Verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer. terms_version=2026-11-23. Payment: Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

scale.description: Optional hint for how to interpret score. Default is 0-100, with backward-compatible heuristics for -1..+1 and 1-5.

score.description: Canonical 0-100 (50 is neutral). For outlook subjects: 0 very negative, 100 very positive. For ai_endpoint quality: 0 poor, 100 excellent. Also accepted: -1..+1 or 1-5 (normalized). Optional scale=0-100|-1..+1|1-5.

short_pass.description: If true, pay 5x the call price for a 5-minute pass (up to 20 calls to this same endpoint, any parameters). After paying, retry with the same credential or the X-Pass token.

subject.description: Allowlisted stock ticker, crypto coin, AI model, AI topic, or AI endpoint (e.g. AAPL, BTC, gpt-4o, ai-buildout, ai_intuitive).

tags.description: Optional fixed tags. No free text.

terms_version.description: Must be the current terms version (see the tool description).

type.description: Optional subject type. Stocks, cryptos and AI only.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
